title: Tailwise Grooming Salon Prepaid Passes: Repeat Missed Bookings Multiplier
content:
**Repeat missed bookings on a prepaid pass — Tailwise Grooming Salon** (Express Bath, Bath & Tidy, Full Groom and Spa Groom passes).

The repeat multiplier of the pass late-cancellation fee counts the missed bookings of the pass dated within the last 6 whole calendar months before today, a missed booking being a no-show or a cancellation recorded with a fee remedy, the cancellation now being charged included, while cancellations recorded with no remedy are not missed bookings:

| Missed bookings on the pass in the last 6 whole calendar months | Repeat multiplier |
|---|---|
| three or more | 2.0 |
| exactly two | 1.5 |
| fewer than two | 1 |

The repeat multiplier multiplies the pass late-cancellation fee as a whole.

**What counts, entry by entry (salon history of the same pass)**

| Entry dated within the window | Counts as a missed booking |
|---|---|
| no-show | yes |
| cancellation recorded with a fee remedy, including the one now being charged | yes |
| cancellation recorded with no remedy (free cancellation) | no |
| completed visit, redo, booking | no |

Only the pass in question is counted; entries on another pass of the customer are not.

**Examples (hypothetical pass, today 15 September)**

| History of the pass | Count | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| the cancellation now being charged, nothing else | 1 | 1 |
| that cancellation and a no-show in July | 2 | 1.5 |
| that cancellation, a no-show in July and a fee-remedy cancellation in May | 3 | 2.0 |
| that cancellation and a no-show two years earlier | 1 | 1 |
| that cancellation and two free cancellations in August | 1 | 1 |

On a fee basis of 20.00 the multiplier of 1.5 gives 30.00, and the multiplier of 2.0 gives 40.00.
